steps.title: Cream the shortening and sugar
steps.body: Cream **½ cup shortening** and **¾ cup sugar**.

steps.title: Add the egg
steps.body: Add **1 egg** and beat until light.

steps.title: Add the flour and milk
steps.body: Add and mix: **1 cup flour**, **½ cup milk**, **1 cup flour** (again), **2½ tsp baking powder**, **¼ tsp salt** and **2 cups blueberries** (frozen).

steps.title: Pour into the pan
steps.body: Pour the mixture into an 11×7 pan.

steps.title: Make the topping
steps.body: Mix then sprinkle on top: **½ cup sugar**, **½ cup flour**, **½ tsp cinnamon** and **¼ cup butter or margarine**.
